verdict.rationale: Vercel documents first-party access to build logs and runtime logs. Its official MCP server exposes `get_deployment_build_logs`, `get_runtime_logs` and `get_runtime_errors`, the CLI can retrieve logs, and there is a Logs overview for runtime logs. However, the evidence never shows a single unified view combining build, deploy and runtime logs, and retention is plan-dependent. Missing for 10: an explicitly documented single unified log view spanning build, deploy and runtime, detail on dashboard log UX, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can view all my build, deploy, and runtime logs in one place

citations.quote: Vercel MCP tools let your AI assistant work with your projects, deployments, logs, and other Vercel resources.
enabling you to retrieve logs, manage certificates, replicate your deployment environment locally
Retention depends on your plan and whether Observability Plus is enabled; see Runtime Logs for current limits.
